note: Toddler-friendly events in North Portland, Sauvie Island, Portland and Vancouver, soonest first. Some holiday dates come from guides or listings rather than the organizers, so check before going.

events.title: Toddler Storytime at St. Johns Library
events.detail: Weekly toddler storytime on Tuesdays, 12:30 to 1:15 p.m., with books, songs, rhymes and movement; free. Space can be limited, so check the branch calendar for the next date.

events.title: Christmas Ships Parade (Vancouver shore)
events.where: Vancouver Waterfront Park and Grant Street Pier, Vancouver, WA
events.detail: Lighted boats parade on the Columbia from late November through Dec. 18, about 45 to 60 minutes per night, per Visit Vancouver WA. Check the nightly schedule; weather can cancel a night.

events.title: Santa Photos: An Elf Christmas Experience at Vancouver Mall
events.detail: Santa visits and photos in H&M Court on the lower level, daily through Dec. 24 (closed Thanksgiving and Christmas Day); reservations recommended but not required. Sensory-friendly Santa is Dec. 7 at 9 a.m. Price not listed.

events.title: Pittock Mansion: Home for the Holidays
events.detail: The mansion decorated for 'Holidays from Around the World'; days and times vary. PDX Parent lists children under 6 free.

events.title: ZooLights
events.detail: Wildlife-themed holiday lights opening Nov. 20; the zoo's page says the run goes through Jan. 3, 2027, closed Nov. 24 to 26 and Dec. 25. Listings give a 4:30 p.m. nightly opening. Timed tickets online, with a TriMet ride included. Go early in the evening with little ones.

events.title: U-cut Christmas trees at Sauvie Island Farms
events.detail: The farm's blog says its U-cut tree field opens Nov. 21 to Dec. 24, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m.; all trees $60.

events.title: Topaz Farm Holiday Market and Christmas trees
events.detail: Holiday market with Christmas trees and wreaths. Community event listings disagree on opening day (Nov. 25, 26 or 29) and the farm hasn't confirmed season hours, so check before going.

events.title: Pioneer Courthouse Square Tree Lighting
events.detail: The 42nd annual lighting, 5:30 to 6:45 p.m., with a community sing-along led by Thomas Lauderdale and Santa switching on the 75-foot tree; free. Date and time per a family events guide.

events.title: Vancouver Community Tree Lighting
events.detail: Free; festivities from 3 p.m. with live music, carriage rides and treats, and Santa arrives escorted by the Christmas Ships. The tree is lit in the evening (listings say 6 or 6:30 p.m.).

events.title: Christmas Festival of Lights at The Grotto
events.detail: Nightly holiday lights, 5 to 9:30 p.m., closed Christmas Day, per The Grotto. PDX Parent lists ages 2 and under free.

events.title: Winter Wonderland drive-through lights
events.detail: Drive-through holiday light show benefiting Sunshine Division, with some walking nights; nightly Nov. 27 to Dec. 31 per listings. Easy with a toddler since you stay in the car.

events.title: Holiday Express steam train
events.where: Oregon Rail Heritage Center (next to OMSI), Portland
events.detail: About 45-minute round trip along the Willamette in decorated, heated cars with Santa aboard. Ticket listings give Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays Nov. 27 to Dec. 27; the center hasn't posted its own 2026 schedule in search results, and tickets sell out, so book ahead.

events.title: Seaside Parade of Lights (Yuletide in Seaside)
events.detail: Illuminated floats and holiday music as part of a weekend of Yuletide events, per Visit the Oregon Coast. Start time and route for 2026 aren't listed yet; past years ran in the early evening.

events.title: The Polar Express at OMSI
events.detail: Screenings of The Polar Express, listed Dec. 11 to 16; OMSI's page doesn't show the year, so confirm before buying.

events.title: Peacock Lane
events.detail: A block of homes decorated for the holidays, free to walk; a lights guide lists Dec. 15 to 31, 2026, with walking-only nights Dec. 15 and 16. The street's own site still shows last year, so the dates are not yet officially confirmed.
